learn.hook: Germs are too tiny to see, but soap and water can chase them away!
points: Germs are tiny living things that can make us ill. We cannot see them with our eyes.
Wash your hands with soap and water for at least 20 seconds, before eating and after using the toilet.
Brush your teeth twice a day, bathe every day, keep nails short and wear clean clothes.
Cover your mouth and nose with a tissue or your elbow when you cough or sneeze.
Drink clean, safe water. Do not let water collect in old tyres or pots, because mosquitoes breed in still water.

example.q: Think it through: Ishaan played in the mud and now wants to eat a samosa. What should he do first, and why?
steps: His hands touched mud, which may have germs.
If he eats now, the germs can go into his mouth.
Washing with soap removes the germs.
example.answer: He should wash his hands with soap and water, so germs do not enter his body with the food.

learn.reallife: Hum 'Happy Birthday' twice while washing your hands. That takes about 20 seconds!

games.title: Steps to wash your hands
games.prompt: Put the handwashing steps in order
items: Wet your hands with clean water
Put soap on your hands
Rub palms, backs, fingers and nails for 20 seconds
Rinse off the soap with water
Dry your hands with a clean towel

games.title: Healthy habit or unhealthy habit?
items: Brushing teeth twice a day
Bathing every day
Cutting nails regularly
Sneezing into your elbow
Eating with dirty hands
Leaving water in old tyres
Sharing someone else's toothbrush
Throwing garbage on the street

quiz.q: For how many seconds should we rub our hands with soap?
quiz.explain: Rubbing hands with soap for at least 20 seconds removes most germs.
steps: Rub hands with soap for at least 20 seconds.
Answer: 20
quiz.mistake: Thinks a quick splash of water is enough

quiz.q: How many times a day should we brush our teeth?
quiz.explain: Brushing in the morning and at night keeps teeth and gums healthy.
steps: Brush in the morning and at night.
Answer: Twice
quiz.mistake: Does not know the healthy brushing routine

quiz.q: What is the best way to cover a sneeze?
options: Sneeze into your hands and touch the door
Sneeze into your elbow or a tissue
Do not cover it at all
quiz.explain: Using your elbow or a tissue stops germs from spreading to others and to things you touch.
steps: Covering a sneeze stops germs spreading.
Use your elbow or a tissue, not your hands.
Answer: Sneeze into your elbow or a tissue
quiz.mistake: Thinks covering with bare hands is the best way

quiz.q: Mosquitoes lay their eggs in…
options: still water in pots and tyres
quiz.explain: Mosquitoes breed in still water. Emptying pots and tyres helps stop them.
steps: Mosquitoes breed in still water.
Old pots and tyres can hold still water.
Answer: still water in pots and tyres
quiz.mistake: Does not know where mosquitoes breed

quiz.q: When must you wash your hands?
options: Before eating and after using the toilet
quiz.explain: Germs can be on hands even when they look clean, so we wash before eating and after the toilet.
steps: Wash hands before eating and after using the toilet.
Germs can be there even when hands look clean.
Answer: Before eating and after using the toilet
quiz.mistake: Thinks hands are clean if they look clean

quiz.q: Why should we keep our nails short and clean?
options: Dirt and germs can hide under long nails
quiz.explain: Germs collect under long nails and can go into our mouth while eating.
steps: Dirt and germs collect under long nails.
They can enter our mouth while eating.
Answer: Dirt and germs can hide under long nails
quiz.mistake: Does not know nails can carry germs

quiz.q: Why can't we see germs?
options: They are too tiny for our eyes
quiz.explain: Germs are so tiny that we need a microscope to see them.
steps: Germs are tiny living things.
They are too small for our eyes; we need a microscope.
Answer: They are too tiny for our eyes
quiz.mistake: Thinks germs are not real because we cannot see them

quiz.q: Which water is safe to drink?
options: Water left open for many days
quiz.explain: Boiling or filtering water kills or removes germs, making it safe to drink.
steps: Safe water is clean water.
Boiling or filtering removes or kills germs.
Answer: Boiled or filtered clean water
quiz.mistake: Thinks all water that looks clear is safe

teach.ask: Gappu thinks his wings are clean because they look clean. Why must he wash with soap?
teach.praise: Clean and clever! Germs are too tiny to see, so washing with soap keeps us from falling ill.
teach.nudge: What tiny things on our hands can make us sick?

revise.summary: Germs are tiny living things that can make us ill. Washing hands with soap, brushing twice, bathing, short nails, covering sneezes and clean water keep us healthy.
focus: When and how to wash hands
remember: Wash hands with soap for at least 20 seconds, before eating and after the toilet
Brush twice a day; keep nails short
Sneeze into your elbow or a tissue
Mosquitoes breed in still water; boil or filter drinking water
traps: Hands that look clean can still have germs.
Don't sneeze into your hands and then touch things.

learn.hook: Kho-kho, kabaddi, cycling or skipping: your body loves to move!
points: Exercise and outdoor play make our muscles, heart and bones strong.
Children should be active for about one hour (60 minutes) every day.
Yoga helps the body bend and stretch and calms the mind. International Day of Yoga is on 21 June.
Sleep helps the body rest and grow. Children your age need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep every night.
Too much screen time and sitting still for long is not good. Take breaks to move and play.

example.q: Think it through: Neel plays outside for 25 minutes and does yoga for 15 minutes. How many more minutes should he be active to reach 60 minutes?
steps: 25 + 15 = 40 minutes so far.
60 − 40 = 20 minutes more.

learn.reallife: Make a weekly play chart at home. Tick each day you play outside for an hour.

games.title: Fitness facts
items: Outdoor play helps make our bones and muscles strong.
Running, jumping and climbing make the body strong.
Children need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep each night.
Sleep gives the body time to rest and grow.
International Day of Yoga is on 21 June.
It is celebrated every year on 21 June.
Watching TV all day keeps us fit.
Sitting still for long hours is not good. We need to move and play.
Kabaddi and kho-kho are Indian games that keep us active.
These games need running, chasing and quick moves.

items.q: Sleep from 9 pm to 6 am = ? hours

quiz.q: About how long should children be active every day?
quiz.explain: Children should play or exercise actively for about 60 minutes, or one hour, every day.
steps: Children should be active for about one hour every day.
1 hour = 60 minutes.
Answer: 60 minutes
quiz.mistake: Thinks a very short time of play is enough

quiz.q: On which date is International Day of Yoga celebrated?
quiz.explain: International Day of Yoga is celebrated every year on 21 June.
steps: International Day of Yoga is on 21 June.
Answer: 21 June
quiz.mistake: Mixes up special days of the year

quiz.q: Why do we need sleep?
options: To help the body rest and grow
quiz.explain: During sleep the body rests, repairs itself and grows.
steps: During sleep the body rests, repairs and grows.
Answer: To help the body rest and grow
quiz.mistake: Thinks sleep is a waste of time

quiz.q: Diya sleeps from 9 pm to 7 am. How many hours does she sleep?
quiz.explain: From 9 pm to 12 midnight is 3 hours, and from 12 to 7 am is 7 hours. 3 + 7 = 10 hours.
steps: 9 pm to 12 midnight = 3 hours
12 midnight to 7 am = 7 hours
3 + 7 = 10 hours
Answer: 10
quiz.mistake: Miscounts the hours when the time crosses midnight

quiz.q: Which of these is the healthiest way to spend an evening?
options: Lying on the sofa eating chips
quiz.explain: Outdoor play keeps the body active. Long screen time and late nights are not healthy.
steps: Outdoor play keeps the body active.
Long screen time and late nights are not healthy.
Answer: Playing outdoors with friends
quiz.mistake: Thinks screen games count as exercise

quiz.q: Which of these is an Indian outdoor game?
quiz.explain: Kho-kho is a running and chasing game played in teams.
steps: Kho-kho is a team running and chasing game.
Answer: Kho-kho
quiz.mistake: Does not know Indian outdoor games

quiz.q: How does yoga help us?
options: It makes the body flexible and calms the mind
quiz.explain: Yoga stretches the body and slow breathing helps the mind feel calm.
steps: Yoga helps the body bend and stretch.
It also calms the mind.
Answer: It makes the body flexible and calms the mind
quiz.mistake: Does not know the benefits of yoga

quiz.q: Rohan plays for 40 minutes before school. How many more minutes of play does he need to make one hour?
quiz.explain: One hour is 60 minutes. 60 − 40 = 20 minutes more.
steps: 1 hour = 60 minutes
Answer: 20
quiz.mistake: Adds 40 and 60 instead of subtracting

teach.ask: Gappu sits on a branch all day. How can he stay fit and strong?
teach.praise: Yay! Playing, exercising, doing yoga and sleeping well keep us strong and healthy. Gappu is going for a fly!
teach.nudge: What should Gappu do with his body every day, and what should he do at night?

revise.summary: Exercise and outdoor play make muscles, heart and bones strong. Children should be active about one hour a day, sleep 9 to 12 hours and take breaks from screens.
focus: How much activity and sleep children need
Healthy ways to spend free time
remember: Be active about 60 minutes every day
Sleep about 9 to 12 hours every night
Kho-kho is an Indian outdoor game
traps: Hours of cartoons or mobile games are not healthy play.
Sleep is not a waste of time; the body rests and grows.

learn.hook: Happy, sad, angry, scared, excited: feelings are like the weather inside us!
points: Everyone has feelings, like happy, sad, angry, scared, worried and excited. All feelings are normal.
Talking about our feelings to a trusted adult, like a parent, grandparent or teacher, helps us feel better.
When angry, we can take slow deep breaths, count to ten or walk away for a while before we speak.
Being kind, sharing and including others makes everyone feel happy and safe.
If someone bullies you or touches you in a way that feels unsafe, say 'No', move away and tell a trusted adult.

example.q: Think it through: Zoya is upset because her drawing got torn. What can she do to feel better?
steps: It is normal to feel sad or upset.
She can take a few deep breaths to calm down.
She can talk to her mother or teacher about it.
She might fix the drawing with tape or make a new one.
example.answer: Calm down with deep breaths, talk to a trusted adult, and then try to fix or redo the drawing.

learn.reallife: Make a feelings chart. Each evening, draw a face that shows how you felt that day.

games.title: Feeling and what to do
pairs: Take deep breaths and count to ten
Tell an adult and keep a night lamp

games.title: Feelings: true or false?
items: All feelings, even anger and sadness, are normal.
Everyone feels angry or sad sometimes. What matters is how we handle it.
Hitting someone is a good way to show anger.
We can calm down and use words instead of hurting anyone.
Talking to a trusted adult can help when we feel worried.
Sharing a worry makes it lighter, and adults can help.
We should keep it a secret if someone bullies us.
Always tell a trusted adult, so they can help stop it.
Kind words can make someone's day better.
Kindness helps others feel happy and safe.

quiz.q: Which of these is a feeling?
quiz.explain: Excited is a feeling. Table, mango and bicycle are things.
steps: Feelings: happy, sad, angry, scared, worried, excited.
Table, mango and bicycle are things.
Answer: Excited
quiz.mistake: Mixes up feelings with objects

quiz.q: Kunal feels very angry. What is a good thing to do?
options: Take slow deep breaths and count to ten
quiz.explain: Deep breaths and counting help us calm down before we speak or act.
steps: When angry, take slow deep breaths or count to ten.
Answer: Take slow deep breaths and count to ten
quiz.mistake: Thinks anger must come out by hurting things or people

quiz.q: Who is a trusted adult you can share worries with?
quiz.explain: Parents, grandparents and teachers know you and want to keep you safe.
steps: A trusted adult knows you and keeps you safe.
Parents, grandparents and teachers are trusted adults.
Answer: A parent, grandparent or teacher
quiz.mistake: Does not know who is safe to talk to

quiz.q: A new girl in class sits alone at lunch. What is the kind thing to do?
options: Invite her to sit and eat with you
quiz.explain: Inviting her to join makes her feel welcome and happy.
steps: Being kind and including others makes them feel safe.
Answer: Invite her to sit and eat with you
quiz.mistake: Does not think about how others feel

quiz.q: Someone in the bus touches you in a way that makes you feel unsafe. What should you do?
options: Say 'No', move away and tell a trusted adult
Keep quiet and tell no one
quiz.explain: Your body belongs to you. Say no, get away and tell an adult you trust.
steps: If touched in an unsafe way: say 'No', move away, tell a trusted adult.
Answer: Say 'No', move away and tell a trusted adult
quiz.mistake: Thinks it is better to stay silent

quiz.q: Are feelings like sadness and fear normal?
quiz.explain: All people have all kinds of feelings. They are a normal part of life.
steps: Everyone has feelings, and all feelings are normal.
Answer: Yes, everyone has them sometimes
quiz.mistake: Thinks some feelings are wrong to have

quiz.q: Priya's friend is crying because she lost a race. What can Priya say?
options: 'It's okay. You ran really well. Let's practise together.'
quiz.explain: Kind, encouraging words help a friend feel better.
steps: Kind, encouraging words help a sad friend.
Answer: 'It's okay. You ran really well. Let's practise together.'
quiz.mistake: Does not understand how words affect feelings

quiz.q: Why is it good to talk about our worries?
options: It makes worries feel lighter and others can help
quiz.explain: Sharing a worry with someone you trust can make you feel better, and they may help solve it.
steps: Talking to a trusted adult helps us feel better.
They may also help solve the problem.
Answer: It makes worries feel lighter and others can help
quiz.mistake: Thinks hiding worries is better

teach.ask: Gappu feels angry and sad today and does not know what to do. Can you help him?
teach.praise: Thank you! All feelings are okay, and talking to someone or taking deep breaths helps. Gappu feels better already!
teach.nudge: What can Gappu do to calm down, and who can he talk to?

revise.summary: Everyone has feelings, and all feelings are normal. Talking to a trusted adult, calming down when angry and being kind help us. If something feels unsafe, say 'No', move away and tell a trusted adult.
focus: Staying safe from bullying or unsafe touch
remember: When angry: slow deep breaths, count to ten, walk away
Unsafe touch: say 'No', move away, tell a trusted adult
traps: A stranger online is not a trusted adult.
It is never your fault if someone touches you in an unsafe way.
